parity.notes: WS5 probe pair (loop plan D5.1, class W5-B). Convention: decls = 1 module/static class + functions; complexity = 1 per function + 1 per conditional branch. Reference: 1 + 6 functions; QuoteWithSurcharge 2, QuoteWithFloor 2, four others 1 = complexity 8. Starting fixtures: identical 4-function module in both arms, both carrying the injected boundary defect (QuoteWithSurcharge 2 + three others = 5). Probe pairs are never gate-eligible: they measure M-W1/PP-W1 (gates doc Annex A-1.2), not the language gates.

wedgeWhitelistCheck: One contract: §S (<= result cap) on QuoteWithSurcharge — scalar i32 comparison against a parameter, inside the Z3-modeled forms whitelist. Per Annex A-1.2 the probe's catch channel is the Debug-mode RUNTIME guard, not static verification (#807 refutes result-referencing postconditions spuriously; not build-blocking). No preconditions (a Proven precondition elides its guard, #755). All code is pure and first-order: no effects, no delegates, no dispatch.
